name: mascot-explainer
_comment: Learned from ONE reference (an illustrated mascot explainer reel). Values marked in style-notes.md as single-source should be re-checked when more references are added. Sections after 'grade' (scenes, mascot, labels, layout) describe the illustrated-scene format; the talking-head renderer ignores them.

script.hook_formula: A 'How to <outcome> <situation>?' question shown as a handwritten title card, followed by 'Explained by <Mascot>'. Then a third-person setup line about the mascot's situation.
structure: setup: the mascot's situation in the third person, ending on the problem
4 to 6 steps signposted First / Now / Next / Then / Finally
each step: an instruction, 3 to 4 concrete examples, then a one-line moral in the metaphor
comment-keyword CTA using the metaphor word
pun sign-off that reuses the metaphor
voice: narrate the mascot in the third person by name; give the viewer second-person instructions
pick ONE running metaphor from the mascot's world and never break it (reference: money = bones, household = the pack, home = doghouse)
short declarative and imperative sentences; no greeting, no self-introduction
hook_examples: How to budget your paycheck after moving in together? Explained by Doggy
Doggy and partner just moved in together. Two paychecks, one home. And suddenly Doggy has way more bones to pay for.
moral_examples: Give those bones a job before they disappear.
No asking where did all your bones go.
script.cta_pattern: If you <have the problem>, comment <metaphor word> and <Mascot> will send you <resource>. Now go <outcome> without <metaphor pun>.
cta_examples: If you don't know how to set up a budget, comment bones and Doggy will send you his budgeting app to help track your expenses. Now go build your new home without eating all the bones.

scenes.camera: none: no zooms or pans; change scale by cutting to a different mascot drawing
exceptions: a single slide or merge per video to illustrate an operation (reference: two piles slide together for 'add both paychecks')

mascot.drawing: hand-inked: thick dark outline, flat fills, no shading, cream chest

poses.use: partner or relationship beats; the second character uses the same drawing with a small variation
listing examples within a step; one card or sticker swapped above the head per example; arms boil
a joke beat (reference: top hat and suit for 'spending money')

textCard.ring: metaphor doodles (reference: about 9 bones) that boil

labels.stickers: flat icon-pack style objects (checklist, calendar badge, cheque) above the mascot
labels.dataCard: one realistic UI/data card at the top of the frame, swapped per example

audio.voiceover: single narrator, wall to wall, breaths cut out
